title: Support 50 steps for font weight theming options
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Theming parameters that define font weights in Streamlit (e.g. `headingFontWeights`) require 100 steps (e.g. 400, 500, 600, ...). Some UI systems use a font weight of 550 though. It would be great if we could support that in all theming config options that set a font weight.
